topic_zh: 可用性的几个 9：99.9% 一年能挂多久
topic_en: The nines of availability: how much downtime 99.9% allows

xhs.title: 99.9% 可用，一年能挂多久？
xhs.body:
系统设计第 7 课：可用性的几个 9
停机时间 = (1 − 可用性) × 8760 小时（按 365 天估算）
99% ≈ 3.65 天，99.9% ≈ 8.76 小时（每月约 43.8 分钟），99.99% ≈ 52.6 分钟，99.999% ≈ 5.26 分钟
每多一个 9，停机缩到十分之一，但要多副本、多机房、自动切换，成本高得多
串联的依赖要相乘：两个 99.9% 串起来 ≈ 99.8%，能挂的时间差不多翻倍
考考你：99.95% 一年能挂多久？A 约 4.4 小时，B 约 44 分钟。评论区告诉我～

linkedin.title: 99.9% uptime still allows almost 9 hours of downtime a year
linkedin.body:
Downtime = (1 − availability) × 8,760 hours (365-day year).
99% ≈ 3.65 days, 99.9% ≈ 8.76 hours (≈ 43.8 min a month), 99.99% ≈ 52.6 min, 99.999% ≈ 5.26 min.
Each extra nine cuts downtime tenfold, and costs far more: replicas, more data centers, automatic failover.
Dependencies in a chain multiply: two 99.9% parts in a row give about 99.8%, nearly double the downtime.
Quick quiz: how much downtime does 99.95% allow a year? A) about 4.4 hours B) about 44 minutes. Answer in the comments.

quiz.q_zh: 可用性 99.95%，一年（365 天）能挂多久？A 约 4.4 小时，B 约 44 分钟
quiz.q_en: How much downtime does 99.95% availability allow in a 365-day year? A) about 4.4 hours B) about 44 minutes
quiz.answer_en: Answer: A. 8,760 hours × 0.05% = 4.38 hours, about 4.4 hours. 44 minutes is what 99.9% allows per month.
